title: The Land of Light and the Eternity Within
description: Inside the sealed garden. T21 — the inmost country where everything that lives, lives from him; no falsity can enter because nothing here has been claimed; no death can enter because nothing here is cut off from the source; the living medicine, the ambrosia that is itself alive, the gifts of the Greatness received as gifts and so remaining forever. T22 — the eternity of what the Lord gives, which stands from before any beginning the soul can name: what is received is older than the rational that hears it, the good is older than the love that is warmed by it; contrasted with the natural-as-claimed whose end is fixed within itself. The sealed garden has been entered. The Beloved is in his garden. State 4 will now begin.
